description: This file defines a custom UploadFile class extending Starlette's UploadFile, including methods for file operations and validation, along with internal utility classes and functions related to default values.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A class representing an uploaded file, extending Starlette's UploadFile with additional attributes and async methods for file operations.

classes.name: DefaultPlaceholder
classes.description: A utility class used internally to recognize overwritten default values.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Asynchronously writes bytes to the file, running in a threadpool for async compatibility.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Asynchronously reads bytes from the file, running in a threadpool for async compatibility.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Asynchronously moves the file pointer to a specified position.

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Validates that the input value is an instance of StarletteUploadFile.

methods.name: __get_pydantic_json_schema__

methods.name: __get_pydantic_core_schema__
methods.description: Returns core schema for Pydantic validation, using a custom validator.
